query:
SELECT s.build FROM buildsteps s
            JOIN BuildStepOutputs o
              ON s.build = o.build
              AND s.stepnr = o.stepnr
            WHERE s.startTime != 0
              AND s.stopTime != 0
              AND s.status = 1
              AND s.drvPath = $1
              AND o.name = $2
            ORDER BY s.attempt DESC LIMIT 1
